Subject: Exploring Redwood trial options for POC — NovaMed

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks again for a great demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and the items we discussed that will determine the POC path:

- Use case: structured-extraction and summarization of clinician notes (mostly de-identified) into our EHR staging area.
- Success criteria (high level): 1) accuracy >= 92% on our 200-item golden set, 2) end-to-end inference latency <= 600ms for 256-token prompts under 95th percentile, 3) throughput to sustain 30 concurrent requests during batch run, and 4) auditability (request logs + KV cache eviction visibility).
- Security constraints: If we must process any PHI, we need BAA and either a VPC/private deployment or a dedicated sandbox with strict retention limits.
- Ops question: What is the fastest path to get a meaningful evaluation running in our environment (hosted trial vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC peering)? Cost and timeline sensitivity: we can accept up to a 3-week ramp if private hosting is required.

Can you send a concise evaluation plan (success criteria mapping, recommended environment, timeline, owners, and procurement asks)? Also please include any SOC2 / compliance docs and a high-level cost estimate for the 3-week POC.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Below is a short execution plan we propose plus the tradeoffs between the three environment options so you can pick what aligns with procurement and risk appetite. I attached a one-page success-criteria doc and a spreadsheet that maps infra options to lead time / cost.

1) Recommended evaluation plan (3-week lightweight POC):
   - Week 0 (kickoff & access): sign BAA, exchange minimal infra info, decide environment (hosted sandbox vs dedicated vs VPC).
   - Week 1 (ingest & baseline): run the golden set against Redwood hosted endpoint (or dedicated sandbox) to get baseline accuracy + latency metrics.
   - Week 2 (integration & scale tests): run batch ingest, evaluate throughput and caching behavior; iterate prompt templates and KV cache warmup.
   - Week 3 (final validation & handoff): validate metrics, produce ops runbook (caching policy, quantization profile), and capture cost projections for prod.

2) Environment summary & tradeoffs:
   - Hosted trial (fastest, low setup; recommended to get initial accuracy/latency baselines). Limitations: cannot guarantee VPC-level isolation, not suitable for PHI unless scoped and covered by BAA + strict retention rules.
   - Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPU pool managed by Redwood, per-customer tenancy): best for realistic throughput and cost profiling; data isolation and longer retention controls available; lead time ~7–10 business days.
   - VPC trial (customer-managed VPC peering / private deployment): full control, meets strict HIPAA/PHI controls, integrates with your KMS; longest onboarding (~2–3 weeks) and requires network coordination.

3) Proposed success criteria (we'll instrument metrics to avoid ambiguity):
   - Accuracy: >= 92% F1 on 200-item golden set (scoring script attached).
   - Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end < 600ms for 256 tokens (measured from your client to our endpoint).
   - Throughput: sustain 30 concurrent small requests and demonstrate batch throughput of at least X tokens/sec in dedicated sandbox.
   - Observability: request-level logs + per-token cost breakdown available for every run.

4) Owners / next steps:
   - Redwood: Rishi (sales/POC coordination), Marissa (Infrastructure lead for onboarding), Redwood Solutions team (runbook + instrumentation).
   - NovaMed: Alex (ML lead), Priya (procurement), Eng oncall for network (TBD).

5) Procurement asks / docs:
   - We will sign a BAA prior to any PHI processing.
   - SOC2 summary and redacted SOC attest report attached.
   - Cost estimate: hosted baseline (2–3x cheaper to iterate); dedicated sandbox ~USD 6k–10k for a 3-week reserved window depending on GPU class; VPC onboarding costs add setup fees (TBD).

Action items: please confirm (A) environment choice (hosted baseline vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC), (B) whether you need us to propose a BAA template or use your legal's, (C) preferred kickoff window (we have availability next week Wed/Thu).

I attached: novamed-poc-success-criteria.pdf, redwood-trial-option-compare.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Hi Rishi — looping in procurement items so we can scope internal approvals. A few clarifying questions: 

1) Does Redwood sign a standard BAA? If yes, can you share the latest template for our legal review?
2) Data retention: for the dedicated sandbox option, can you confirm default retention and options to configure shorter retention (e.g., 30 days or purge on-demand)?
3) Audit logs: will request/response logs include redaction controls for any PHI we later discover, or do we need to manage redaction before sending?
4) Cost model: we need a ballpark for the 3-week dedicated sandbox and an estimate for the VPC onboarding fee to budget for approvals.

Thanks — if it's easier we can do a quick 15-min call after your reply.

—Priya

Priya — quick answers inline and a few actionable proposals so procurement can move forward: 

1) BAA: Yes — Redwood will sign a BAA. I attached our standard BAA template; if you prefer to start from your template, happy to review.
2) Retention: Dedicated sandbox default retention is 90 days; we can configure shorter retention (30 days) for the trial and offer an on-demand purge prior to handing back any logs. We'll document the purge procedure in the runbook.
3) Audit logs / redaction: We recommend you remove PHI before sending if that is operationally possible. If you need to send PHI, we can enable log redaction at ingest and provide a redaction policy; note that some redaction approaches affect traceability of model inputs. We'll include options in the runbook.
4) Cost: Estimated pricing for a 3-week dedicated sandbox: USD 8,250 (NVIDIA A10-class equivalent pool). VPC onboarding estimate: USD 4,000 one-time setup (networking and security review), typical lead time 10–14 business days after kickoff. Exact quotes to come once you confirm GPU class and required SLOs.

Next steps I propose (pick one):
- Option A (fastest): Hosted baseline this week to validate accuracy + latency; then upgrade to dedicated sandbox for scale tests.
- Option B (compliant-first): Begin with dedicated sandbox and 30-day retention; kickoff next Wed 12/8.

I'll drop a 15-min slot for Wed 12/1 10:30am PT if that works for you — calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/poc-kickoff-novamed

If you confirm Option B, we'll start the BAA + procurement packet and Marissa will coordinate the sandbox provisioning.

Best,
Rishi
